text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I feel so much better now!
I'm so glad I consulted Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could be of help!
Please feel free to ask anytime." dialog_style="simple"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――... Oww! Must be the atmospheric pressure.
I really ought to take some headache medicine soon...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Top Road-saaan. Can you come help prep for the next class~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Can't make them worry either.
Endure it, just endure it...!

Narita Top Road was unable to rest,
and continued to be plagued by headaches...
